name: Scrying Materials
label: Quest
description: Scrying Materials: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Geologist Larksbane's studies have proven to be of tremendous value to our operations in Silithus. She has recently requested scrying materials to be used in her research.
Please gather these materials and deliver them to her directly so that she may continue her research.
